summary: First Phase 3 E2E pass. Backend: 2 new pytest files (16 tests). 15 pass. 1 real failure: the rate limit can be bypassed by spoofing X-Forwarded-For. Mobile: 4 Playwright scripts at 390x844, about 50 checks. Phase 2 onboarding still reaches the menu. These work: account sign-in/register/forgot/reset, conflict dialog, sign-out, typed-DELETE deletion, Google redirect, child mode, events, inbox claim-once, server missions, support ticket, leaderboard tabs/own-rank highlight/report/offline Retry, offline queue + sync-failed banner + flush with Synced toast, maintenance/update-required/update-available gates, and guest offline play. Found 2 HIGH bugs: (1) the first run started with Play from the menu never calls /runs/start, so it is sent as /runs/offline and never reaches the leaderboard (only Play again does); (2) currency is duplicated across accounts, because sign-out keeps the cloud wallet on the device and the next account linked or registered uploads it.

critical.issue: client_ip uses the first X-Forwarded-For entry, and the client controls that value. Sending a different XFF on each request avoids the limit: 13 logins in a row all returned 401 and none returned 429. Use the last (ingress-appended) hop or a trusted-proxy count.

Currency is duplicated across accounts. Steps: sign in to account A (5555 coins) → Keep cloud → sign out (the device keeps 5555) → sign in to fresh account B (progress_initialized=false) → the device wallet is SET on B. B ended up with 5555 coins and 33 gems, and the ledger shows a link_device_progress entry. Registering a new account after sign-out does the same.

minor.issue: The revive price index comes from the client-chosen ref suffix (':1' = 10 gems). The client can always pay 5 gems, and the ref isn't tied to a real run_id.

ui_bugs.issue: online.startRun() is only called inside the startRun callback (Play again/restart). The first run entered from menu Play starts in the 'countdown' phase without it, so recordRun has no started token and enqueues /runs/offline. Result: the run is off the leaderboard, coins are capped and event progress is not tracked. Verified by network capture: run 1 → only POST /runs/offline; Play again → /runs/start + /runs/finish 200.
The 5 square buttons overflow at 390px wide. 'Leaderboard' is clipped at the left edge and 'Inbox' at the right edge.

integration_issues.flow: Sign out → sign in to another account / register
integration_issues.issue: Sign-out doesn't restore guest progress or clear the cloud-derived wallet, which leads to the cross-account duplication described above.
The Maintenance screen covers the whole app and only has Retry. There is no 'Play offline' option, so guests and offline play are blocked during maintenance.

issues: The Events and Daily buttons use the same calendar icon
The 'Events'/'Account' labels are hard-coded and not localized with t()
Actions are 'Update' plus an X icon; JRN-56 expects 'Update now' / 'Later'
Shows the global list with a sign-in CTA. JRN-57 expects 'Sign in and go online to see global rankings' plus personal bests
The Claim button is hidden until the target is reached instead of shown disabled

react_native_issues.issue: Two main-menu screens end up in the DOM/stack after sign-out (Playwright strict-mode found 2 [data-testid=main-menu]), so Back may lead to another menu. Use router.dismissAll() or a similar call.

action_items: HIGH: call online.startRun(engine.runId, world) for the first run too, on mount or in onCountdownDone, unless it is a tutorial

CRITICAL: stop cross-account currency duplication. On sign-out, restore or snapshot the pre-sign-in guest wallet (or reset the cloud-derived balances). Alternatively, never upload a device wallet whose values came from another account
HIGH: rate limiter must not trust a client-supplied X-Forwarded-For first hop
Fix the menu bottom-bar overflow at 390px (5 buttons)
Maintenance screen: add 'Play offline' and let gameplay continue
Minor: Update banner 'Update now'/'Later'; signed-out leaderboard copy and personal bests; render the event Claim button disabled; give revive pricing a server-side per-run count
critical_code_review_comments: plausibility() rejects duration > server_elapsed+10, so a run is only valid if /runs/start finished before the countdown. If /runs/start is slow or fails, the run is silently downgraded to offline
AccountProvider.linkProgress sends save.coins/gems from whatever the device currently shows, which may be another account's cloud values

success_rate.backend: 94% (15/16; 1 real security failure: XFF rate-limit bypass)
success_rate.frontend: ~94% (46/49 checks; failures: first-run not online, no 'Play offline' on maintenance, menu bar overflow seen in screenshot)

seed_data_creation: Rival got one online daily score of 520 (p3_rival_score.py). Player has online daily score 560, msg_welcome_online claimed and 1 report against Rival. 2 support tickets were created. Player wallet reset to 0/0/0 and progress_initialized=false after the duplication test. Throwaway accounts deleted. Remote config reset to maintenance=false, min 1.0.0, latest 1.0.0. EXPOSE_RESET_CODE_FOR_TESTS was not used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the rr3d p3*.py scripts with python directly. The URL is read from mobile/.env; they use the swiftshader flags. p3a builds /tmp/p3/state_player.json, which p3b/p3c/p3d need. p3a needs /tmp/p3/conf_email, an account registered via the API with progress_initialized=true and a wallet set in mongo (it exercises the conflict dialog). Use [data-testid=X]:visible selectors because the expo-router stack keeps hidden screens in the DOM. The auth rate limit is per XFF IP, so tests send unique X-Forwarded-For headers.
rca_of_issue: Online run bug: RunScreen's initial phase is 'countdown' with the engine created on mount. online.startRun only runs in the startRun callback used by Play again/Restart, so online.runs has no entry for the first runId and recordRun falls back to /runs/offline. Duplication: signOut → online.clearSession() only clears tokens/queue and leaves the GameProvider save (already overwritten by onServerUser with the cloud wallet). The next /me/link for an account with progress_initialized=false takes the 'device' branch and $sets that wallet.
